    Data notes

    Source. 17,672 candidates read from the six PDF text layers: Category A (10,812) and Category B (6,860), each in English, Tamil and Sinhala.

    Cleaning. Stray watermark letters were removed from NIC numbers, genders and school-type codes; split indexes and wrapped names were rejoined. The notes appear on each candidate’s detail card.

    Codes. School type N, NP, P and the qualifier flags P, NP, N are shown as printed; the PDFs don’t state their meanings. Special need (Category B only): ND not disabled, TD temporary disability, PD permanent disability. Subject codes are the three-digit codes as printed.

    New-format NIC. An old NIC (9 digits and V) becomes 12 digits as 19, the first five digits, a zero, then the last four digits. NICs already printed with 12 digits are kept as they are.

    Date of birth. The year is the first four digits of the new-format NIC. The next three digits are the day number, counted as if February always has 29 days, with 500 added for women. Dates are shown as YYYY-MM-DD. Checks: 17,662 of 17,672 genders read from the NIC match the Gender column, and 17,670 dates are valid calendar dates.

    Derived. Subjects selected counts the non-blank subject slots.

    Search. Type part of a NIC in either format, an index number, a date of birth (for example 1990-05) or any words of a name; every word must match.
